request.style: English, male rock voice, raw and urgent, electric guitar, bass, drums, moody and tense, 110 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Old King David could not get warm
Servants searched for a young girl
They found Abishag of Shunem
She served him with gentle care

[Pre-Chorus]
Adonijah claimed he would be king
He took chariots and horsemen
Fifty men ran ahead of him
But the kingdom was not his

[Chorus]
Ask for Abishag as your wife
This request hides a deadly claim
Solomon sees through the veil of lies
The throne is not yours to claim

[Verse]
Zadok and Nathan anoint the heir
At Gihon the trumpet sounds
Long live King Solomon they shout
The succession is now secure

[Pre-Chorus]
Adonijah goes to Bathsheba
He speaks with a humble face
But his heart desires the crown
He tests the new King's grace

[Chorus]
Ask for Abishag as your wife
This request hides a deadly claim
Solomon sees through the veil of lies
The throne is not yours to claim

[Bridge]
Why do you ask for her as wife
Ask for the kingdom as well
For Joab and Abiathar too
This word will cost your life

[Outro]
Benaiah strikes Adonijah down
He dies for his greed
The old King's care becomes a trap
In the court's dark deed
